notes.title: Major Developer Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we are excited to announce big changes for Runaway Animals:


GENERAL CHANGES

- Added different minigames for each task type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536805/4d18970a106ce02d9c24cbecc0dce37aad312dbb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536805/daad2b616265e269d8a7b8cea8e8ff779b75f5ab.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536805/7a853e5939f14355c6535ef34425d7f2d46695cd.png

- Players can now see each other's nicknames floating above their head.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536805/99d3eedc3922a910fca71e17d7d4d35f103a744f.png

- Removed the tasks tutorial.

- Confined the cursor to the game screen.

- Better sound cues when an animal spots a player.

- Added more objects to some environments.

-----------------------------------------

FIXES

- Fixed player falling out the map when trying to perform certain tasks.

- Fixed an issue where players were unable to join when playing in certain regions.

-----------------------------------------

DISCORD SERVER

- Changed the discord server to be mainly about (Runaway Animals) content related.

Please consider joining our discord server:

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536805/688dee716aae17291fe571926fe474dbdd265f97.png 

______________________________

Last but not least, we would be more than grateful if you can leave a review of the game in the store page. It would help us a lot. And also feel free to share the game with your friends.

Thank you for all the support so far.

Roger G Lugo
@ReglStudios

notes.title: Version 0.7.55
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, below you can find a few new changes to the game.

- Better balance of difficulty levels.
- Y-Axis Inversion & Mouse Sensitivity options added to menus.
- Removed some stuttering when looking around.
- You can now create private rooms by turning off the (Public) button during the creation of a room.
- Now you can hide the name of the room on screen if you choose to.

We are still working on the gameplay to make it more engaging.

Join our community to get more updates on our projects and to find more players: https://discord.gg/3VCWwfPmuS

Lastly, Reboot Steam to download the latest release.

Thanks again,

Roger

notes.title: Version 1.7.50
notes.notes:
- Fixed input problem that prevented players from skipping some menus in the game. It was due to an unidentified device being plugged into the computer.

- Fixed flickering in some shadows.

- Some changes in the Japanese translation.

Please reboot Steam to download the most recent version.

Thanks.

notes.title: Version 0.7.41
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue that happened at the end of a cutscene where the loading screen stayed on.

notes.title: Version 0.7.39
notes.notes:
- Fixed graphics options resetting every time the game is opened.

- Now when a player buys a character or clothing variation, the item becomes the currently selected one.
